group_definitions.selection: Fixed before examining outcomes; membership uses configuration only

primary_comparison.practical_assessment: Undetermined: no externally justified minimum meaningful improvement supplied.

secondary_objectives.scope: Descriptive only; no secondary tests, intervals, or significance claims

method.name: Two-sided Welch unequal-variance t test and 95% Welch t interval for mean difference
method.multiplicity: One predeclared primary test; secondary summaries only
method.small_samples: At least two observed outcomes per group; small-sample inference requires approximately normal populations
method.missing: Available outcomes separately by objective; no imputation
method.practical_criterion: A positive externally justified minimum meaningful mean improvement is required; none is assumed in the demo

limitations: Welch inference assumes independent observations within and between groups, finite variances, and approximate normality of sample means; large samples help but do not verify these assumptions.
Rows are observational configurations, not documented random samples. P values and intervals are conditional approximations, not guarantees for this fixed dataset or a wider population.
Other hyperparameters may differ between families; confounding and configuration selection prevent causal attribution to criterion.
Repeated configurations are counted but not assumed to be independent repeated measurements. Unreported dependence can invalidate row-level standard errors.
Missing outcomes may be selective; available-outcome comparisons need not represent missing configurations.
No client-approved practical threshold is available; statistical significance alone cannot establish practical relevance. No equivalence test is performed.
Recorded objective scales only: formulas, physical units, and compute costs are unspecified.
No surrogate predictions are used. This does not establish measurement repeatability for a particular configuration.
The separate required same analysis is not claimed complete; its exact procedure was not supplied.
maintainer_conclusion: Observed primary direction: candidate_worse. A mean difference is detected under the stated sampling assumptions. Undetermined: no externally justified minimum meaningful improvement supplied. This comparison does not certify a causal improvement or repeatability for a particular configuration.
